briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 new models this month with rapid capability jumps. Funding surged to $11.9B while prompt injection attacks remain widespread. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation emerges as a protocol-level countermeasure.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 with 4.2T parameters; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 achieved parity on GPQA at 1/3 cost. Meta and xAI announced training runs exceeding 100k H100 equivalents.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs; Microsoft broke ground on a 5GW Texas supercluster; Google TPU v6 pods reached 10M chips online with 40% efficiency gains.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become mandatory for AGI-scale deployments before 2028?
